message: Round 3, no code change. Report 673b54e80093fea0b861388e730ac7ad6fde8ddb, file .agent-handoff/review-turn-65-arena-blank-design.md. The hold/reuse design is not safe as previously stated. Hold must survive one restore cooldown, but a matching observation after a longer gap starts a new streak at 1 and must not rebind. URL match with no mounted transcript root is hold, not blank. Any in-page heading is the wrong guard: chrome h1 ChatGPT would block a genuine blank page. Clear on a turn node or an in-root heading with unrecognized role, including ChatGPT сказал: and unexpected labels. Root absent holds. Unstructured text with no turn or heading stays unresolved and must not increment. Reuse is one page: pop restore registry, register rebind, one window.name, before goto. Pending rebind must not new_page. commit_rebind does not close the old tab. rebind_completed is false for the new URL, and an empty parse there is blank under a89580f, so a fresh commit must hold, not start a second streak or second bootstrap. Do not send bootstrap while still on the saved URL. Wake is not exactly once: if the committed page is absent, plan_control_page selects the retired CONTROL READY page and canonicalizes back. Send only on the committed durable identity after ready. One visible wake means no further send. Unparsed wake may retry at most 3 times without resetting attempts or consuming the turn. Do not change review-turn-56-arena-debate.md, main, or arena/local-agent-v0.
